summary: The bug report points to ensureInventoryLevels in the inventory module, which validates each entry of a reservation batch against the same un-decremented available_quantity. I tested it with one cart holding two lines that share WIDGET (6 x OVS-PIECE + 3 x OVS-TWOPACK = 12 units against 10 stocked). In all 13 runs the completion succeeded, left 12 WIDGET units reserved against 10 stocked, and no_oversell failed every time. The other four checks passed, which is consistent with the reservation counter summing the same entries. The root cause is the per-entry check in ensureInventoryLevels.
